notes:
User is planning a dinner party centered on spicy mango margaritas. Appetizers: grilled pineapple–prosciutto skewers and spicy shrimp ceviche. Main: grilled jerk chicken with mango salsa and roasted sweet potatoes (olive oil, salt, pepper, aromatics, citrus optional). User enjoys experimenting with jerk seasoning. Dessert: coconut-lime panna cotta with a separate dessert-friendly mango salsa; reduce/omit jalapeño, use ripe mango, balance lime, and optionally add honey/agave, mint/basil, or Grand Marnier.

User enjoys experimenting with cocktails and attends a cocktail-making class on Fridays. They recently developed a Watermelon Basil Margarita: roasted watermelon puree, fresh lime, agave, basil syrup, and Avion Silver, which is their favorite tequila and works well in homemade margaritas. They are excited to try it.

At the upcoming Friday class, they plan to make a Paloma and a Tequila Sour. They are interested in experimenting with grapefruit juice and egg-white cocktails. Suggested future variations include citrus/spice syrups, pink or ruby grapefruit juice, grapefruit/orange accents, and garnishes such as jalapeño, mint, watermelon, or citrus.
